audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows contradicted their own whys: level 1 was 'Skill' under 'Level 1 is yours', levels 2 and 3 were 'Tryndamere' under whys calling both even, levels 4-5 were 'Skill' under a why saying they tilt to Yasuo, and level 6 was 'Skill' under 'Level 6 flips to you'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Tryndamere, Skill, Skill, Yasuo, Tryndamere, Tryndamere, Tryndamere], the whys agree with it row for row, and Tryndamere wins 56.52% over 2801 games.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 realigned in both layers with ratings, and phases[3].why rewritten to state why Yasuo owns that bracket.

audit.why: Yasuo's window is 4-5 on tornado plus Wind Wall uptime; yours is level 6 (Undying Rage) and every item spike after. Last Breath at rank 3 is only a 30s cooldown, which is why the late-game warning about a 5-man knockup chain is right.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive gating condition on Last Breath was never stated, and no cooldowns appeared for Wind Wall, Steel Tempest or Sweeping Blade.
audit.why: Riot kit: Last Breath blinks only to an Airborne enemy champion — with no tornado landed he has no access to it at all in a 1v1. Steel Tempest is a flat 4s and needs two stacks of Gathering Storm to fire the knockup whirlwind, so his knockup is countable. Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17s for 4 seconds and blocks projectiles only. Sweeping Blade cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds, so he cannot chain-dash off you once he has used it.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d with those gates and numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tryndamere's W (Mocking Shout) carries a 'projectile — can be blocked by Wind Wall-class effects' derived flag in the kit file.
audit.why: Riot's own description says he 'lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage' — an around-self effect, not a projectile. The flag contradicts the description, so nothing was written claiming Wind Wall stops your W.
audit.corrected: No edit written on this point; recorded so the flag is not trusted downstream.
sources: champ-data/_kits/tryndamere.json W text vs its projectile flag

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Last Breath's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His tornado, Wind Wall and dash uptime control the spacing before your crit spike. If behind, farm safe and hold your E for escape.

edits.before: His all-in after a knockup. R survives it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Last Breath needs an airborne target — no tornado landed, no ult, all lane long.

edits.before: Yasuo wastes Last Breath — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Sweeping Blade cannot re-dash the same target for a few seconds.

edits.before: That is Yasuo's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Steel Tempest stacks make the knockup — count his Qs, it is a 4s cooldown.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Wind Wall is 25s at rank 1 and blocks projectiles, never your autos.

notes: Kit-file flag conflict recorded: Tryndamere's W is flagged 'projectile / blockable by Wind Wall' but Riot's text describes an around-self shout. Nothing was written claiming Wind Wall blocks Mocking Shout — this needs confirming before any page asserts either way.
